declaredIdentity: tenant/weekly-work-digests/v5(tenant,member+Monday); scheduleKey exact checked, deterministic DeliveryKeyFor(attempt). Request/result retry compares exact identity/actor/outcome; expected Revision used for new transitions.
invariant: Technical delivery process invariant: exactly one schedule per member-week; only next deterministic attempt can run and callback must match its exact request; terminal outcomes/suppression stop further delivery.
boundaryRationale: Keep one durable per-member-week delivery process state; history of attempts can be an operational projection while current/selected callback intent remains durable. No business aggregate boundary is justified by SMTP scheduling alone.
logicalPhysicalRule: Logical technical responsibility is separate from physical storage/owner. Existing native operational journals may remain where required for exact recovery; this inventory does not require conversion to KV/CAS or count them as business authority.
